  - `receptor_mitigation_frontier(H, W, thresholds, options, budget, weights=None, z=1.96)`：枚举预算内每受体选一方案的非支配缓解方案前沿。`options`/`budget` 契约及 `TypeError`/`ValueError` 与 `receptor_mitigation_plan` 相同（外层/分组非序列抛 `TypeError`，长度不符、空分组、项非二元抛 `ValueError`，`r`、`c`、`budget` 类型错抛 `TypeError`，非有限或负抛 `ValueError`）；五参与 `receptor_excess_interval` 同契约。对每种组合，`C=fsum(c_i)≤budget` 时令 `H′[k][i]=H[k][i]−r_i`，调用 `receptor_excess_interval(H′, W, thresholds, weights, z)` 得 `(M,R,L,U)`，`S=fsum(max(U[i][j],0))`、`D=fsum(R[i][j])`、`G=Σ[L[i][j]>0]`（`i<N, j<3`）。仅保留在 `(S,D,G,C)` 上逐项 `≤` 且至少一项严格更小的方案不被任何其他方案支配者；无可行组合抛 `ValueError`。返回按 `(S,D,G,C,choice)` 升序排列的 list，每项为 `(choice, C, S, D, G, (M,R,L,U))`，`choice` 为 N 长 0 基选项下标的 `list[int]`，均不舍入
  - `policy_recommend(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budget, weights=None, z=1.96)`：为每个非支配缓解方案搭配最优运行预警策略。除 `quantiles`、`policies` 外，参数约束与每种错误条件的异常类型沿用 `receptor_mitigation_frontier`；二者沿用 `receptor_count_run_policy_batch`（故 K≥2）。令 `F=receptor_mitigation_frontier(H,W,thresholds,options,budget,weights,z)`；对其中 `(choice,C,S,D,G,interval)`，构造 `H′[k][i]=H[k][i]−options[i][choice[i]][0]`，以 `H′` 代替 `H` 调用批量函数得 `(results,scores,order)`，令 `p=order[0]`、`o=results[p]`、`a=max(o[1])`、`s=scores[p]`。返回各 `(choice,p,C,S,D,G,a,s,interval,o)` 组成的 list，按 `(S,D,G,C,−a,−s,choice,p)` 升序；内部类型、形状沿既有返回，数值不舍入
  - `robust_policy_summary(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budget, weight_sets, z=1.96)`：在多组情景权重下稳健地挑选预算内的缓解方案与运行预警策略（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。除 `weight_sets` 外，参数约束与每种错误条件的异常类型沿用 `policy_recommend`（故 K≥2）。`weight_sets` 为非空 L×K list/tuple 矩阵，元素为非 bool 有限非负数，各行 `fsum>0` 后按 `fsum` 归一；容器/行/元素类型错抛 `TypeError`，空、锯齿、行长不等于 K、非有限、负值或行零和抛 `ValueError`。枚举每个预算内 `(choice,p)`（`choice` 为每受体各选一选项且成本 `C=fsum(c_i)≤budget`，`p` 遍历全部策略）：构造 `H′[k][i]=H[k][i]−options[i][choice[i]][0]`，对每权重行 `w` 调用 `receptor_excess_interval(H′,W,thresholds,w,z)` 得 `I=(M,R,L,U)`，按 `p` 的策略参数调用 `receptor_count_run_warning` 得 `o`。令 `S=fsum(max(U[i][j],0))`、`D=fsum(R[i][j])`、`G=Σ[L[i][j]>0]`（`i<N, j<3`）、`a=max(o[1])`、`s=fsum(o[4][K−1])`；对每一权重行，所有 `(choice,p)` 按 `(S,D,G,C,−a,−s,choice,p)` 升序赋 0 基名次，`ranks` 收齐该对的 L 个名次。取 `(max(ranks),fsum(ranks),choice,p)` 最小者，返回 `(choice,p,ranks,metrics,intervals,o)`：`choice` 为 N 长 0 基选项下标 `list[int]`，`p` 为 int，`ranks` 为 L 长 `list[int]`，`metrics` 含 L 个 `(S,D,G,C,a,s)`，`intervals` 含 L 个 `(M,R,L,U)`，`o` 沿 `receptor_count_run_warning` 既有结构，数值不舍入；无可行组合抛 `ValueError`
  - `robust_policy_report(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budget, weight_sets, z=1.96)`：多组情景权重下稳健方案与预警策略的 JSON 兼容摘要（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。参数约束与每种错误条件的异常类型沿用 `robust_policy_summary`，异常原样传播。仅调用 `robust_policy_summary` 一次取 `(choice,p,ranks,metrics,intervals,o)`，返回键依次为 `choice`、`policy`、`robustness`、`weights`、`warning` 的 dict：`choice` 为 `choice` 的 list 副本，`policy` 为 `p`；`robustness` 为 `[max(ranks), fsum(ranks), list(ranks)]`；`weights` 按 `weight_sets` 序，第 l 项为 `[S,D,G,C,a,s,M,R,L,U]`，前六值取 `metrics[l]`，后四值取 `intervals[l]` 并复制为二维 list；`warning` 按 `o` 中 `[runs,levels,triggers,first,cumulative]` 的顺序，所有内层容器递归转 list，`None` 保留；数值不舍入
  - `robust_policy_sensitivity(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budget, weight_sets, zs)`：稳健方案与预警策略对区间倍数 `z` 的敏感性扫描（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。除 `zs` 外，参数约束与每种错误条件的异常类型沿用 `robust_policy_report`，异常原样传播。`zs` 为非空 list/tuple，元素为非 bool 有限 int/float、≥0 且严格递增；容器或元素类型错抛 `TypeError`，空、非有限（含 int 转 float 溢出）、负值或非递增抛 `ValueError`。对每个 `z` 按序以其余同参仅调用一次 `robust_policy_report`，结果记 `R[r]`。将 `R` 中相同 `(choice,policy)` 分组，`S` 按首次出现序存 `[choice副本, policy, 次数]`；`D` 第 r 行为 `R[r+1]` 与 `R[r]` 的 `robustness[2]` 逐项之差，`G` 第 r 行为两者 `warning[1]` 逐项之差；仅一个 `z` 时 `D`、`G` 为空。返回键依次为 `z`、`reports`、`selection_counts`、`rank_changes`、`level_changes` 的 dict，值依次为 `zs` 转 float 的 list、`R`、`S`、`D`、`G`，均按 `zs` 及原 `weight_sets`/`quantiles` 序；全部容器 JSON 兼容，`None` 保留，数值不舍入
  - `robust_policy_grid(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budgets, weight_sets, zs)`：稳健方案与预警策略在预算×区间倍数网格上的扫描（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。除 `budgets`、`zs` 外，参数约束与每种错误条件的异常类型沿用 `robust_policy_report`，异常原样传播；`budgets`、`zs` 均沿用 `robust_policy_sensitivity` 的 `zs` 契约（非空 list/tuple，非 bool 有限 int/float、≥0 且严格递增；容器或元素类型错抛 `TypeError`，空、非有限含 int 转 float 溢出、负值或非递增抛 `ValueError`）。以 `budgets` 为外层、`zs` 为内层，每格 `(budget,z)` 以其余同参仅调用一次 `robust_policy_report`，结果组成 B×Z 矩阵 `R`。`stability[b]` 按 `z` 序存同 `(choice,policy)` 选择的极大连续段，每段为 `[首z, 末z, choice副本, policy]`。`rank_changes`、`level_changes` 均为键依次 `z`、`budget` 的 dict：`z` 值为 B×(Z−1) 矩阵，取 `R[b][r+1]` 与 `R[b][r]` 的 `robustness[2]`（或 `warning[1]`）逐项后减前；`budget` 值为 (B−1)×Z 矩阵，取 `R[b+1][r]` 与 `R[b][r]` 的同项差；单点轴对应维度为空。返回键依次为 `budgets`、`z`、`reports`、`stability`、`rank_changes`、`level_changes` 的 dict，前两项为 `budgets`、`zs` 转 float 的 list，`reports` 即 `R`；均按 `budgets`/`zs` 及原 `weight_sets`/`quantiles` 序，全部容器 JSON 兼容，`None` 保留，数值不舍入
  - `robust_policy_grid_turns(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budgets, weight_sets, zs)`：稳健网格状态沿预算与区间倍数两轴的转折点扫描（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。参数约束与每种错误条件的异常类型沿用 `robust_policy_grid`，异常原样传播；仅调用 `robust_policy_grid` 一次得 `G`。状态 `S[b][r]=[choice副本, policy, robustness[2]副本, warning[1]副本]`，取自 `G["reports"][b][r]`，依次表示方案、策略、各权重名次、各分位预警等级。z 轴相邻状态按 b 升序、再按 `r=1..Z−1` 比较；budget 轴相邻状态按 `b=1..B−1`、再按 r 升序比较。仅状态不等时记事件 `[[前b,前r],[后b,后r],前状态,后状态,fields]`，`fields` 按 `choice,policy,ranks,levels` 顺序列出变化项。返回键依次为 `budgets`、`z`、`states`、`z_changes`、`budget_changes` 的 dict：前两项为 `G` 同名浮点列表副本，`states` 为 B×Z 状态列表，后两项为上述扫描序事件列表；无变化或对应轴单点时为空，多次变化全部保留。全部容器 JSON 兼容，数值不舍入
  - `robust_policy_grid_regions(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budgets, weight_sets, zs)`：稳健网格上等状态单元的正交连通分区（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。参数约束与每种错误条件的异常类型沿用 `robust_policy_grid_turns`，异常原样传播；仅调用 `robust_policy_grid_turns` 一次得 `G`。坐标 `[b,r]` 仅与上下左右四个单元相邻；两单元状态按 `G["states"]` 对应列表值是否相等判定。按 b 外层、r 内层扫描未归属单元，从该单元出发泛洪填充，将同状态且正交可达的单元归为一区；区域 id 自 0 按扫描序递增，每区成员按 `(b,r)` 升序。每个区域为键依次 `id`、`cells`、`budget_bounds`、`z_bounds`、`state` 的 dict：`cells` 为成员 `[b,r]` 列表；`budget_bounds` 为成员 b 极小、极大下标对应预算组成的二元 float 列表，`z_bounds` 为成员 r 极小、极大下标对应 z 值的二元 float 列表；`state` 为该状态的递归 list 副本。任意两个不同区域存在正交相邻成员即形成边 `[小id, 大id]`，去重后按两 id 升序排列。返回键依次为 `budgets`、`z`、`states`、`regions`、`adjacency` 的 dict：前三项为 `G` 同名值的递归 list 副本，`regions` 按 id 序，`adjacency` 为边列表。全部容器 JSON 兼容，`None` 保留，数值不舍入
  - `robust_policy_region_flow(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options, budgets, weight_sets, zs)`：稳健网格分区在预算轴与区间倍数轴上逐片的流动（仅自 `air_quality.health` 导出，不入包根）。参数约束与每种错误条件的异常类型沿用 `robust_policy_grid_regions`，异常原样传播；仅调用 `robust_policy_grid_regions` 一次得 `G`，以 `G` 的区域给每个单元 `[b,r]` 赋区域 id，组成 B×Z 的 id 网格。固定 b 沿 r 扫、固定 r 沿 b 扫两种切片分别压缩为同 id 的极大连续段，每段记 `[首坐标, 末坐标, id, state副本]`（首、末为该片扫描方向的下标，state 为该区域状态的递归 list 副本），段在片内按扫描序自 0 递增编号。相邻两片的段共享同一 id 且下标区间相交（共享单元跨片相接）即连边；在两张有序段表间的连边图为二部图，依段序求其连通分量（含孤立段），每个分量按前段数→后段数记一个事件 `[kind, from, to, overlap]`：`from`/`to` 为该片段下标的升序列表，`overlap` 为各连边交集坐标（budget 片为 r 下标、z 片为 b 下标）去重后的升序并集，`kind` 依 `0→多、多→0、1→1、1→多、多→1、多→多` 取 `enter、exit、continue、split、merge、merge_split`。片内相邻且异 id 的单元对组成去重升序边集；每对相邻片记 `[前片, 后片, 新增边, 移除边]`（两边集之差，边为 `[小id,大id]`）。返回键依次为 `budgets`、`z`、`axes` 的 dict：前两项为 `G` 同名值副本，`axes` 为键依次 `budget`、`z` 的 dict，各值为键依次 `slices`、`events`、`adjacency_changes` 的 dict——`slices` 按片列各片段表，`events` 按相邻片对列各分量事件，`adjacency_changes` 按相邻片对列边集差；轴上仅一片时 `events`、`adjacency_changes` 为空。全部容器 JSON 兼容，`None` 保留，数值不舍入

def receptor_count_run_policy_batch(
    H: list[list[float]] | tuple[tuple[float, ...], ...],
    W: list[list[float]] | tuple[tuple[float, ...], ...],
    thresholds: list[float] | tuple[float, ...],
    quantiles: list[float] | tuple[float, ...],
    policies: list | tuple,
) -> tuple[list[tuple], list[float], list[int]]:
    """Batch-evaluate run-warning policies and rank them.

    ``H``, ``W``, ``thresholds`` and ``quantiles`` share the contract of
    :func:`receptor_count_run_warning` (every ``TypeError`` and
    ``ValueError`` is inherited verbatim). ``policies`` is a non-empty
    list or tuple; each entry must be a list or tuple of exactly five
    values ``(level, minimum_count, d1, d2, d3)``, all five non-bool
    ints. A wrong container, entry or element type raises ``TypeError``;
    an empty ``policies``, an entry of length other than 5, a ``level``
    outside ``0..3``, a ``minimum_count < 1``, or durations that are not
    positive, not strictly increasing or not ``<= K`` raise
    ``ValueError``.

    For each policy ``p`` the durations ``(d1, d2, d3)`` are passed as
    ``durations`` to :func:`receptor_count_run_warning` with the
    policy's ``level`` and ``minimum_count``. ``results[p]`` stores that
    call's ``(runs, levels, triggers, first, cumulative)`` tuple and
    ``scores[p] = fsum(cumulative[K - 1])`` over the three duration
    columns.

    Returns ``(results, scores, order)`` where ``results`` is a
    P-long ``list[tuple]``, ``scores`` a P-long ``list[float]`` and
    ``order`` a P-long ``list[int]`` of 0-based policy indices sorted
    ascending by ``(-max(levels), -scores[p], p)``. Inner shapes follow
    :func:`receptor_count_run_warning` and values are not rounded.
    """
    if not isinstance(policies, (list, tuple)):
        raise TypeError(
            f"policies must be a list or tuple, got {type(policies).__name__}"
        )
    if len(policies) == 0:
        raise ValueError("policies must not be empty")

    results: list[tuple] = []
    scores: list[float] = []
    peaks: list[int] = []
    for p, policy in enumerate(policies):
        if not isinstance(policy, (list, tuple)):
            raise TypeError(
                f"policies[{p}] must be a list or tuple, "
                f"got {type(policy).__name__}"
            )
        if len(policy) != 5:
            raise ValueError(
                f"policies[{p}] must have exactly 5 elements, "
                f"got {len(policy)}"
            )
        values: list[int] = []
        for e, item in enumerate(policy):
            if not isinstance(item, int) or isinstance(item, bool):
                raise TypeError(
                    f"policies[{p}][{e}] must be an int, "
                    f"got {type(item).__name__}"
                )
            values.append(item)
        level, minimum_count, d1, d2, d3 = values
        if not 0 <= level <= 3:
            raise ValueError(
                f"policies[{p}][0] level must be between 0 and 3, got {level}"
            )
        if minimum_count < 1:
            raise ValueError(
                f"policies[{p}][1] minimum_count must be >= 1, "
                f"got {minimum_count}"
            )
        durations = (d1, d2, d3)
        for j, d in enumerate(durations):
            if d < 1:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"policies[{p}][{j + 2}] must be >= 1, got {d!r}"
                )
            if j > 0 and d <= durations[j - 1]:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"policies[{p}] durations must be strictly increasing, "
                    f"got {list(durations)!r}"
                )

        outcome = receptor_count_run_warning(
            H,
            W,
            thresholds,
            quantiles,
            durations,
            level=level,
            minimum_count=minimum_count,
        )
        runs, run_levels, triggers, first, cumulative = outcome
        results.append(outcome)
        scores.append(math.fsum(cumulative[-1]))
        peaks.append(max(run_levels))

    order = sorted(
        range(len(results)),
        key=lambda p: (-peaks[p], -scores[p], p),
    )

    return results, scores, order

def robust_policy_action_batches(
    H: list[list[float]] | tuple[tuple[float, ...], ...],
    W: list[list[float]] | tuple[tuple[float, ...], ...],
    thresholds: list[float] | tuple[float, ...],
    quantiles: list[float] | tuple[float, ...],
    policies: list | tuple,
    options: list | tuple,
    budgets: list[float] | tuple[float, ...],
    weight_sets: list[list[float]] | tuple[tuple[float, ...], ...],
    zs: list[float] | tuple[float, ...],
    capacity: int = 10,
) -> dict:
    """Conflict-priority action queue split into fixed-size batches.

    Every parameter except ``capacity`` shares the contract of
    :func:`robust_policy_actions` (every ``TypeError`` and
    ``ValueError`` is inherited verbatim; exceptions propagate
    unchanged). :func:`robust_policy_actions` is called exactly once to
    obtain ``A``. ``capacity`` must be a non-bool int >= 1; a wrong type
    raises ``TypeError`` and a value below 1 raises ``ValueError``.

    ``A["queue"]`` is sliced in its original order, ``capacity`` actions
    per batch (the last batch may be shorter). For a ``"region"`` action
    its 0-based entries 7 and 8 are the rank and level impact; for a
    ``"pair"`` action its 0-based entries 6 and 7 are. Within each batch
    those impacts are summed with ``math.fsum`` to give ``R`` and ``L``;
    ``CR`` and ``CL`` are the ``math.fsum`` of every ``R`` and ``L`` up
    to and including that batch.

    Returns a dict whose keys in order are ``budgets``, ``z``,
    ``capacity`` and ``batches``: the first two values copy the
    same-named values of ``A``, and each batch is a dict whose keys in
    order are ``id``, ``range``, ``items``, ``rank``, ``level`` and
    ``cumulative``, with values the 0-based batch id, the half-open
    interval ``[start, stop]`` of queue indices, recursive copies of the
    actions, ``R``, ``L`` and ``[CR, CL]``. An empty queue gives empty
    ``batches``. Every container is JSON-compatible, ``None`` is
    preserved and no value is rounded.
    """
    if not isinstance(capacity, int) or isinstance(capacity, bool):
        raise TypeError(
            f"capacity must be an int, got {type(capacity).__name__}"
        )
    if capacity < 1:
        raise ValueError(f"capacity must be >= 1, got {capacity}")

    actions = robust_policy_actions(
        H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options,
        budgets, weight_sets, zs,
    )

    def _copy(value: object) -> object:
        if isinstance(value, list):
            return [_copy(item) for item in value]
        return value

    queue = actions["queue"]
    batches: list[dict] = []
    cumulative_rank: list[float] = []
    cumulative_level: list[float] = []
    for batch_id, start in enumerate(range(0, len(queue), capacity)):
        stop = min(start + capacity, len(queue))
        items = queue[start:stop]
        rank_terms: list[float] = []
        level_terms: list[float] = []
        for action in items:
            if action[1] == "region":
                rank_terms.append(action[7])
                level_terms.append(action[8])
            else:
                rank_terms.append(action[6])
                level_terms.append(action[7])
        rank_total = math.fsum(rank_terms)
        level_total = math.fsum(level_terms)
        cumulative_rank.append(rank_total)
        cumulative_level.append(level_total)
        batches.append(
            {
                "id": batch_id,
                "range": [start, stop],
                "items": [_copy(action) for action in items],
                "rank": rank_total,
                "level": level_total,
                "cumulative": [
                    math.fsum(cumulative_rank),
                    math.fsum(cumulative_level),
                ],
            }
        )

    return {
        "budgets": _copy(actions["budgets"]),
        "z": _copy(actions["z"]),
        "capacity": capacity,
        "batches": batches,
    }

from air_quality import health as h

assert "robust_policy_action_batches" in h.__all__
import air_quality
assert not hasattr(air_quality, "robust_policy_action_batches")

# capacity validation happens before delegating (junk other args still OK)
for bad in [True, False, 1.0, 10.0, "10", None, [10], 0j]:

        h.robust_policy_action_batches(None,None,None,None,None,None,None,None,None,bad)
    except TypeError as e:
        assert "capacity must be an int" in str(e), (bad, e)
    else:
        raise AssertionError(("expected TypeError", bad))

for bad in [0, -1, -10]:
    try:
        h.robust_policy_action_batches(None,None,None,None,None,None,None,None,None,bad)
    except ValueError as e:
        assert "capacity must be >= 1" in str(e)
    else:
        raise AssertionError(("expected ValueError", bad))

# Happy path: K=3 scenarios, N=1 receptor
H = [[1.0], [2.0], [3.0]]
W = [[0.5], [0.5], [0.5]]
thresholds = [1.0, 2.0, 3.0]
quantiles = [0.5]
policies = [(3, 1, 1, 2, 3)]
options = [[(0.0, 0.0)]]
budgets = [0.0, 10.0]
weight_sets = [[1.0, 1.0, 1.0]]
zs = [1.0, 2.0]

A = h.robust_policy_actions(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies, options,
                            budgets, weight_sets, zs)
q = A["queue"]
print("queue len:", len(q), "kinds:", [a[1] for a in q][:5], "...")

for cap in (1, 2, 3, 100):
    B = h.robust_policy_action_batches(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies,
                                       options, budgets, weight_sets, zs, cap)
    assert list(B.keys()) == ["budgets", "z", "capacity", "batches"]
    assert B["capacity"] == cap
    assert B["budgets"] == A["budgets"] and B["z"] == A["z"]
    # independence from A
    B["budgets"].append(999); B["batches"] and B["batches"][0]["items"].append("x")
    assert A["budgets"] == [0.0, 10.0]

    B = h.robust_policy_action_batches(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies,
                                       options, budgets, weight_sets, zs, cap)
    batches = B["batches"]
    assert len(batches) == math.ceil(len(q) / cap)
    # ranges cover queue exactly, in order
    covered = []
    run_R, run_L = [], []
    for bid, b in enumerate(batches):
        assert list(b.keys()) == ["id","range","items","rank","level","cumulative"]
        assert b["id"] == bid
        start, stop = b["range"]
        assert stop - start == len(b["items"])
        assert (stop - start) <= cap
        covered.extend(range(start, stop))
        R, L = [], []
        for a in b["items"]:
            if a[1] == "region":
                R.append(a[7]); L.append(a[8])
            else:
                R.append(a[6]); L.append(a[7])
        assert b["rank"] == math.fsum(R)
        assert b["level"] == math.fsum(L)
        run_R.append(b["rank"]); run_L.append(b["level"])
        assert b["cumulative"] == [math.fsum(run_R), math.fsum(run_L)]
        # items equal queue slice by value and are independent copies
        for item, orig in zip(b["items"], q[start:stop]):
            assert item == orig
            item.append("mutated")
            assert "mutated" not in orig
    assert covered == list(range(len(q)))
    json.dumps(B)  # JSON compatible
    last = batches[-1]
    print(f"cap={cap}: {len(batches)} batches, last range {last['range']}, "
          f"cumulative {last['cumulative']}")

# default capacity = 10
Bd = h.robust_policy_action_batches(H, W, thresholds, quantiles, policies,
                                    options, budgets, weight_sets, zs)
assert Bd["capacity"] == 10
assert all(len(b["items"]) <= 10 for b in Bd["batches"])

# Empty-queue style: totals may be zero; json contains null preserved somewhere
s = json.dumps(Bd)
print("json ok, bytes:", len(s))
print("ALL CHECKS PASSED")
